trail_ridge.basis: opens the last week in May, closes to through travel mid-October to early November

old_fall_river.basis: open early July to early October

independence_pass.basis: closed late October or November until the week before Memorial Day

mount_blue_sky.basis: summit open Memorial Day through Labor Day

going_to_the_sun.basis: alpine section closes by the third Monday of October, opens late June

beartooth_mt.basis: open Friday of Memorial Day weekend to about Oct 15

yellowstone_grand_loop.basis: closes early November, opens mid-April to late May; Mammoth to Tower stays open

tioga.basis: closed sometime in November through late May or June

sonora_pass.basis: closed from the first big storm; reopened May 15 2025, May 16 2024, Jun 9 2023

glacier_point.basis: closed beyond Badger Pass from November through late May or early June

lassen.basis: closes mid to late November, reopens late May to July

north_cascades.basis: closed MP 134-171 from November or December to late April or May

chinook_pass.basis: closes mid-November, reopens around Memorial Day

hurricane_ridge.basis: part-time in winter, which closures.py deliberately leaves open

crater_lake_rim.basis: closes Nov 1 or earlier; West Rim opens mid-May to late June, East Rim to late July

mirror_lake.basis: closed through winter, typically November through May or June

mt_washington_auto_road.basis: 2026: weekends only Apr 25 - May 22, daily May 23 - Nov 1

needles_hwy.basis: closes with the first snow, reopens no earlier than April 1
